turns.sourceQuestion: What happens when a parcel gets a shipping hold?

answer.text: When the carrier cannot validate the delivery address, I am the fulfilment coordinator who puts the parcel on the hold rack. I clear it only after the customer confirms the corrected address. Separately, blue notes are cancellations and Noor handles those.

turns.sourceQuestion: What lets you take the parcel off the hold rack?

answer.text: The green carrier tick tells me the parcel has been released from the hold rack. Damaged parcels are the exception and stay held for the claims team.

turns.sourceQuestion: What does Noor check before a blue cancellation note is finished?

answer.text: She checks that the parcel has not been scanned by the carrier, then cancels the label. The blue note is finished when the label number is crossed out; if it was already scanned, she sends it to returns instead.
